title: Sean Payton says its about ‘getting those touches’ for WR Marvin Mims Jr.

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton says its about ‘getting those touches’ for WR Marvin Mims Jr.
sources.description: “He’s been very consistent. It’s just a matter of getting those touches. But very important games, even in Buffalo—I could point to a number of games. It’s a good problem to have, but he’s doing well.”
